item.title: 'The Crown' star Claire Foy says she battled ‘disgusting’ stomach parasites for five years
item.description: Claire Foy parasite infection lasted five years after "The Crown" star believes she contracted stomach parasites during a trip to Morocco, causing unexplained weight loss.

item.title: Brantley Gilbert shares why he's performing at Turning Point USA's alternate halftime show
item.description: Country music singer Brantley Gilbert revealed why he decided to perform at Turning Point USA's "The All-American Halftime Show" Sunday.

item.title: Joy Reid says GOP using Nicki Minaj as a 'house pet' to put 'blackface' on MAGA
item.description: Former MSNBC host Joy Reid accused the GOP of using rapper Nicki Minaj for "cultural cool" and needing Black people to give the MAGA movement credibility in a controversial segment.

item.title: Super Bowl Sunday menus are changing; party hosts serve up surprises this year
item.description: Super Bowl hosts are getting more experimental this football season, incorporating inventive dips and health-conscious options into traditional game day menus.

item.title: Skier Lindsey Vonn says ACL is '100% gone' after crash, remains determined for Olympic downhill
item.description: Alpine skier Lindsey Vonn said her ACL is “100% gone" after last week’s World Cup crash. However, she remains determined to compete in Sunday’s Olympic women’s Olympic downhill.

item.title: SBA freezes over 100,000 California borrowers in sweeping $9B pandemic fraud crackdown
item.description: Trump's SBA suspended over 111,000 California borrowers in a massive fraud crackdown involving $9 billion in suspected pandemic loan abuse targeting relief programs.

item.title: Former MLB player Yasiel Puig found guilty of obstruction, lying to federal investigators
item.description: Former MLB outfielder Yasiel Puig was found guilty of obstruction of justice in a federal gambling case. The 35-year-old Cuban-born American faces up to 20 years in prison.

item.title: Canada and France opening new consulates in Greenland's capital amid Trump pressure
item.description: Canada and France are opening new consulates in Greenland's capital following the Trump administration's push to acquire the Danish territory through tariff threats.

item.title: Hegseth says National Guard members shot in DC ambush by Afghan national will receive Purple Heart
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced Purple Heart recognition for two West Virginia National Guard members, one killed and another recovering.

item.title: Hegseth ending military education ties with Harvard amid Trump feud: 'We train warriors, not wokesters'
item.description: War Secretary Pete Hegseth announced Friday that military education programs with Harvard University will end in the 2026-27 academic year.
